brief:
The eighth annual Al-Khader Grape Festival and Market opened in the town of Al-Khader, west of Bethlehem, according to the Palestine News Network. The event is part of a joint initiative by the Palestinian Agricultural Relief Committees designed to help local farmers maintain economic viability and preserve their connection to the land.

The festival provides a direct market platform where agricultural producers can sell their harvest to consumers, bypassing intermediaries and securing better returns for their work. By creating this annual gathering, organizers aim to address pressures facing Palestinian farmers and strengthen their ability to sustain agricultural production in the region.

title: Al-Khader Grape Festival opens to sustain Palestinian farmers' livelihoods
